ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what does the rotifer get its energy from?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, the Rotifer circle is located on the left side toward the middle, the Algae circle is to its left, and there is an arrow pointing from Algae to Rotifer. Rotifer is also connected to other organisms to the right, but the only arrow pointing to Rotifer is this one from Algae. Reasoning: Food web arrows indicate that energy flows from food or source organisms to consumers. The question asks what Rotifer obtains energy from, so one should look at the energy source pointing to Rotifer; that source is Algae.
